name: agent-skills
tagline_zh: 别让AI只会聊天。这里每件技能都像瑞士军刀，开箱即用，专治“让它干活却干不好”的尴尬。试一个，马上不一样。
tagline_en: Stop chatting, start doing. Each skill is a pocket tool—unbox, use, and watch your agent actually get things done.
desc_en: Useful skills for agents and claws.
why_zh: 同类合集多而杂，它只留精品，每个技能都经过实战检验，装了就见效，不浪费你调参的时间。
why_en: Curated, not dumped. Every skill is battle-tested, so you skip the trial-and-error and get straight to working results.
